# HVAC USA: voice

Migrated from live no-slop-copy v1.1. The legacy Baltimore / Timonium / Lutherville showroom references belong to Got Ductless (agency owner, 2026-09-29) and never appear in HVAC USA copy.

- Who we sound like: a specialist who will pick up the phone, size the job, and ship the right boxes.
- Tone: practical, specific, product-literate. Informal is fine. Not cute, not agency-poetic, not corporate ESG. Phone-forward when a human should design the system. Confident about shipping and authorized-channel warranty, never "#1 in America."
- Vocabulary: BTU, SEER2, hyper-heat, line set, cassette, R32, R454B, matchup, draft order.
- Reader segments: homeowner one-room, whole-home, DIY, contractor, property, federal. Default assumption: the reader is buying equipment, not hiring a local contractor.
- One action options: call, request a design, add to cart, pay a draft.

Good: Call (913) 364-0070 and we will size the system before you buy.
Bad: Unlock next-level comfort with our curated ecosystem of innovative climate solutions.

## Format overrides
| Mode | Shape | CTA |
|---|---|---|
| pdp | What is in the box, matchup, refrigerant, voltage, heat performance, warranty path. | Call + add to cart |
| collection / landing | Range + filter first screen. Series and styles from our catalog. Install BOM, not attach-poetry. Title Case H2s allowed. | Call or design request |
| quote-followup | Restate rooms / BTUs / what ships. Next step and date. | Pay or answer one question |

## Portable-filler fix
A line that could run on HVACDirect, eComfort, or ACWholesalers unchanged gets one of our facts attached: Kansas City warehouse (**CONFIRM**), conventional systems, phone trust → draft order/estimate → online purchase, Lennox and Trane, (913) 364-0070.

## Before / after
Before: `The launch of this system marks a pivotal moment for homeowners seeking efficiency.`
After: `This line uses R32. Confirm the indoor and outdoor are the same refrigerant before you order.`

Before: `Feel free to reach out with any questions!`
After: `Reply with rooms, approx. sq ft, and whether you need heat below freezing. Or call (913) 364-0070.`
